title: Large topologically, small in measure
promptMarkdown: Construct a dense open subset $O\subset[0,1]$ (open in the relative topology) with $m(O)<1/10$. Prove its complement is closed, has empty interior relative to $[0,1]$, and has positive measure. Explain why this does not contradict the Baire category theorem.
hintLadder: Use a countable dense set and the previous covering construction.
Distinguish the category statement from a statement about length.

criteria.criterion: Constructs the dense open set with a rigorous measure bound.
